units.source_text: 髭黑大将想道：虽说是患心病，但此种举动，荒唐太甚，从来不曾见过。

en.t: General Higekuro thought: although it was said to be a sickness of the heart, such behavior was far too absurd, and he had never seen anything like it.

units.source_text: 他懊恼之极，便厌恶这夫人，刚才对她的怜爱之心都消失了。

en.t: He was utterly distressed, and came to detest the lady; all the pity and affection he had felt for her just moments before vanished.

units.source_text: 但念此时倘把事情闹大，深恐发生意外之变，只得忍气吞声。

en.t: But thinking that if he made a commotion now some unexpected disaster might occur, he had no choice but to swallow his anger and remain silent.

units.source_text: 不管时已夜半，派人召请僧众，大办祈祷法会。

en.t: Though it was already midnight, he sent people to summon monks and held a grand service of prayers.

units.source_text: 此时夫人正在大声叫骂，髭黑大将听了她的声音，觉得讨厌之极。

en.t: At this time the lady was shouting curses at the top of her voice, and when General Higekuro heard her, he found it unbearably repellent.
For this, he could hardly be blamed.

units.source_text: 由于祈祷的法力，夫人有时似乎挨打，有时跌倒在地，闹了一夜，直到天明，方始疲极而睡。

en.t: Under the power of the prayers, the lady at times seemed to be beaten, and at times fell to the floor; after making a disturbance all night, she finally collapsed into exhausted sleep at dawn.

units.source_text: 此时髭黑大将管自写信与玉鬘。

en.t: Meanwhile General Higekuro simply wrote a letter to Tamakazura himself.

units.source_text: 信中言道：“昨夜此间有人身患暴病，几乎死亡；

en.t: In the letter he wrote: Last night someone here was struck by a sudden illness and nearly died;

units.source_text: 加之大雪纷飞，行路困难。

en.t: moreover, heavy snow was swirling down, making travel difficult.

units.source_text: 踌躇竟夕，周身冷不可当。

en.t: I hesitated through the entire night, and my whole body became unbearably cold.

units.source_text: 未能前来欢叙，此情当蒙原鉴。

en.t: I was unable to come and enjoy conversation with you, and I hope you will kindly understand the circumstances.

units.source_text: 但不知旁人如何猜度耳。”

en.t: I only wonder how others may interpret it.
He also added a poem, saying:
